findings.title: A session that ends while the sign-in page is shown never clears the session-scoped query cache: the next identity to sign in in that tab (development form, or a /me re-probe after an IdP sign-in in another tab) is shown the previous user's cached records
findings.reproduction:
FE10 moved the session-end rule into the API client (apps/web/src/api/client.ts:99 endSession: a 401 `unauthenticated` while the phase is "active" makes it "ended"). The cache is cleared only by <RequireSession> (apps/web/src/auth/session.tsx:52-58: claimSessionEnd() then queryClient.removeQueries()), so only when that component is mounted, or mounts later while the phase is still "ended". The sign-in page is outside <RequireSession> (apps/web/src/app/router.tsx:38). It re-probes /me on mount (apps/web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx:60, refetchOnMount "always") through the same client, so a 401 there ends the session but clears nothing. The next successful GET /me then sets the phase back to "active" (apps/web/src/api/queries.ts:62 markSessionActive), the end is never claimed, and the sign-in page navigates to returnTo (LoginPage.tsx:70) with the previous user's queries still cached.
The precondition is the sign-in page being shown in the same document while the phase is "active". That happens when the browser Back button returns to an in-document /login history entry, for example one pushed by the sign-in page's own wordmark link (LoginPage.tsx:80), after the user signed in in that document (development form, or a refocus /me re-probe after an IdP sign-in in another tab).
Probe: docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/code-security/round-14/probes/zz-sec-r14-web-probe.test.tsx (sha256 2b64ba54), copied into a disposable clone of candidate 9f3ca298 (d99de98), unit-web project, jsdom, the product's own fixtures, SYNTHETIC data. Identical on Node 22.22.2 and Node 24.21.0 (probe-web-node22.log, probe-web-node24.log).
W5 (development sign-in): user A is on /transformations and sees TR-A-SECRET. A's session ends, and the tab goes Back to /login?returnTo=%2Ftransformations: GET /me 401, phase "ended", and 1 transformations query is still cached. User B signs in with the development form (POST /auth/dev-login 204, GET /me 200 as "Synthetic User B"). The app navigates to /transformations, and with B's list request still in flight the page shows B's name and A's row TR-A-SECRET.
W5b (OIDC mode, development sign-in 404): same, but B signs in at the IdP in another tab and this tab's /me is re-probed (as refetchOnWindowFocus does in production). Same result: B sees TR-A-SECRET.
Control: when the session ends while <RequireSession> is mounted (the product's own session-end.test.tsx, and W6 here), the cache is cleared and nothing leaks.
findings.expected: When a session ends, whatever page is shown, the cached identity and every session-scoped query are removed before any later identity can render. A user who signs in afterwards in the same tab never sees records fetched under the previous session.
findings.actual: The cache is cleared only if <RequireSession> observes the "ended" phase. A session that ends on the sign-in page is never claimed. The next sign-in in that tab renders the previous user's cached records (TR-A-SECRET) under the new user's identity, until the new user's own requests replace them. In production (OIDC; development sign-in is refused under NODE_ENV=production) this needs an in-document /login history entry, a session end, Back to that entry, and a different identity signing in on the same browser profile in another tab. Server-side authorisation is intact: no API response ever carries A's data to B; the exposure is data A already held in that tab's memory. Rated Medium, not mandatory, for that reason and the narrow preconditions. Suggested fix: clear the session-scoped cache where the phase changes, independent of which route is mounted (for example a phase subscriber in AppProviders that removes every query when the phase becomes "ended"), or remove every query on any transition into "active" whose user differs from the cached one.

history.note: Raised by code-security-reviewer in DG2 round 14 (T-DG2-REV-SEC-R14) on candidate 9f3ca298; reproduced on Node 22 and Node 24 (W5 development sign-in, W5b OIDC-mode /me re-probe).
